description: This file is a shell script designed as a test suite to verify behaviors of git merge under various scenarios involving file modifications, deletions, untracked files, and directory structures. It defines multiple test cases to ensure git's merge operation handles different edge cases correctly.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Encapsulates creating a commit with specified filename and content.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful completion.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks if a given file or directory is missing.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern within output or files.

methods.name: test_ln_s_add
methods.description: Creates a symbolic link and adds it to the test context.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Defines cleanup actions after a test scenario.
